text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Blend contamination is widespread in this trigger: 534 of 1461 points (about 37%) are flagged blend_suspect, and the listed event points include several BLEND_SUSPECT tags on the dimmest measurements, including the deepest offsets around 1936 to 1951.","evidence_ids":["E-060","E-047","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-053","E-054","E-055"]},{"text":"The downward excursions cluster in the rh, rl, bm and ac series, several of which carry shape-outlier tags, so the dip may reflect a shape or blend artifact in those plate series rather than a stellar change.","evidence_ids":["E-062","E-048","E-049","E-050","E-051","E-055","E-040","E-041","E-021","E-016"]},{"text":"Emulsion effects are flagged: 63 of 1461 points are non-blue emulsion and 3 are unknown emulsion, so colour-dependent plate response could shift magnitudes on some plates.","evidence_ids":["E-058","E-059"]},{"text":"Plate-edge effects are flagged on 75 of 1461 points, and several dim measurements sit on plates whose series have large negative zero-point offsets, which could mimic a dimming at plate margins.","evidence_ids":["E-063","E-024","E-040","E-041"]},{"text":"Calibration seams exist between plate series: the century decade medians drift from about +0.25 in 1880 to about -0.44 in 1960, and series zero points range from -0.49 (dny) to +0.38 (j), so the long-term epoch trend that defines the event may partly reflect series-to-series offsets. The packet also omits 1431 of 1461 points (E-057), so the full distribution cannot be checked here.","evidence_ids":["E-004","E-012","E-026","E-031","E-057","E-011"]}]}
